summary: Configured a 1 GiB file-backed LUKS2 encrypted volume on node1, formatted with XFS and mounted at /srv/secure. It automatically unlocked and mounted after a verified node reboot. RHEL 10.0, the existing kernel, and SELinux enforcing mode were preserved.
actions_performed: Installed supported cryptsetup 2.8.1 from the RHEL BaseOS repository.
Generated a node-local 64-byte boot key protected as root:root mode 0400.
Restricted the container and mount to root access; unprivileged access was denied.
Verified systemd unlock/remount before reboot and automatic recovery after reboot.
Removed the temporary persistence marker; retained /etc/fstab.pre-secure-volume as a root-only rollback copy.

evidence.summary: Shows the LUKS2 header, AES-XTS encrypted mapper, XFS filesystem, and active /srv/secure mount.

evidence.requirement: Automatic unlock and mount at boot
evidence.summary: Shows persistent crypttab/fstab configuration, successful systemd activation from a closed state, and active cryptsetup/mount units after reboot.
The key is mode 0400, key directory and mount are mode 0700, container is mode 0600, SELinux remains enforcing, and nobody cannot access the volume.

evidence.requirement: Retain the installed OS release and kernel; use compatible software
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain installed; cryptsetup 2.8.1 came from the configured RHEL 10 repository.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID was 739c9792-2418-47cc-a875-95b27428f3fc; systemd acknowledged the safe reboot; post-restart boot ID changed to 6bb0ecdb-993e-4536-98f8-1fa33dbc01b1; the system, mapper, mount, data, and access controls recovered.
